purpose: Teach: 腹筋/退治/金髪/トウモロコシ/ねずみ/かぼちゃ/ウイスキー/サウナ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが腹筋運動の本買ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a book about abdominal exercises.
lines.style: Light, gentle observation. Warm amusement in the undertone. Speaking to him as though sharing a small domestic detail — not judgment, just noticing. Calm, steady pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、虫退治の絵本読んでるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm reading a picture book about getting rid of bugs.
lines.style: Bright and matter-of-fact. Clear enunciation on what he's doing, like he's offering her the information as a gift. Small eagerness underneath — wanting her to know what he knows.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの留学時代のお友達、金髪の方よ
lines.en: Sho, one of your dad's friends from his study-abroad days — the one with blond hair.
lines.style: Thoughtful, as if she's turning something over in her mind. Gently bringing it up as though Sho might find it interesting. Slight pause between clauses — not rushing. Warm curiosity in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと畑のトウモロコシ収穫したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I harvested corn from the field today.
lines.style: Proud and direct. Small lift on the opening. His voice carries the quiet satisfaction of work done together. Not boasting — reporting something he's genuinely proud of sharing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本に出てくるねずみ、可愛いわね
lines.en: Sho, the little mouse in that picture book is adorable, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, genuine delight. Soft landing on 'adorable' — she's inviting agreement, not declaring fact. Speaking as one person charmed by something small to another. Conversational, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのかぼちゃ煮、大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love Grandma's pumpkin stew.
lines.style: Simple, genuine affection. Steady tone — this is a true thing he wants to say. No performance. Small warmth underneath, like he's thinking of the taste and the care it represents.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお客様にウイスキーをお出ししたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad served whisky to a customer.
lines.style: Calm, factual delivery. Matter-of-fact but not cold — she's simply noting something she observed. Slight reflective distance, as though she's processing the ordinary detail of his day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサウナに入りたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to the sauna with Dad.
lines.style: Direct and warm. Softness at the edges — not urgent, but genuine wanting. He's speaking to her gently, as though this wish is something he trusts her with. Small lift at the end, hopeful but not demanding.
